capabilities: Compact the workspace spacing and title-bar grid of the Border theme
Align editor tabs, sidebar tabs, window controls, and the Ribbon
Open a pop-up menu of Ribbon actions from a status-bar button
Show or hide the original Ribbon via right-click
Detect the active theme and scope or revert overrides accordingly
disambiguation: Not a standalone theme; it only adjusts the Border theme's layout and requires that theme to be active.
extras: Relies on the DOM structure of the Border theme and Obsidian desktop, so theme or app updates may break it; requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later and desktop only.
intentEvidence: A lightweight desktop-only plugin for the Obsidian Border theme. It combines a compact workspace layout with a pop-up Ribbon menu
problem: The Border theme's default layout wastes spacing and hides Ribbon actions behind the narrow Ribbon, so the author compacted it without a separate CSS snippet.

relations.evidence: A lightweight desktop-only plugin for the Obsidian Border theme.

summary: Desktop-only companion plugin for the Border theme that applies a compact workspace layout and adds a status-bar pop-up menu for Ribbon actions.
